obligations.description: - **Chat thread identity is single-threaded.** `assistant-chat-design.md` shows subagent blocks in thread history but assumes one execution context per thread. Multi-lane concurrency (package overseer A vs. seam overseer B) has no thread-routing model.
exact_items: - **Chat thread identity is single-threaded.** `assistant-chat-design.md` shows subagent blocks in thread history but assumes one execution context per thread. Multi-lane concurrency (package overseer A vs. seam overseer B) has no thread-routing model.
